Human Sensing

Marketplace Conference | 3-4 November 2026, Berlin

 
 

From Human Data Acquisition to Digital Human Modeling

The conference brings together researchers, engineers, technology developers, and industry leaders to explore advances in sensing, simulation, and digital human modeling, and to connect technologies with real-world applications in human health, assistive technology, robotics, and human-machine interfaces.

Interdisciplinary meetup: who should attend

  • Researchers, engineers, and developers in human sensing and digital human technologies

  • Providers of sensing, wearable, simulation, and digital twin technologies

  • Developers of AI, human modeling, and data analysis solutions

  • Industry professionals in health, assistive technology, robotics, rehabilitation, and human-machine interfaces

 

Focal Topics

Human Sensing

  • Wearable sensing

  • Motion capture

  • Biomechanics

Digital Human Modeling

  • Digital twins
